headline: Kudus flood: 1,822 residents still evacuated on 17 January
summary: Per 17 Januari 2026, BPBD Kabupaten Kudus mencatat 1.822 pengungsi banjir, terbanyak di Gedung DPRD Kudus (396 orang). Banjir masih terjadi di sejumlah lokasi meski ketinggian air mulai turun di beberapa tempat.
summary_id: Per 17 Januari 2026, BPBD Kabupaten Kudus mencatat 1.822 pengungsi banjir, terbanyak di Gedung DPRD Kudus (396 orang). Banjir masih terjadi di sejumlah lokasi meski ketinggian air mulai turun di beberapa tempat.
summary_en: As of 17 January 2026, Kudus BPBD recorded 1,822 flood evacuees, the most (396) sheltering at the Kudus DPRD building. Flooding continued at several locations although water was receding in some.
